ambiguities.description: Identification of Review entity via Review role in ternary fact type: The fact type 'Reviewer reviews Paper with Review' links Reviewer, Paper, and Review. The composite uniqueness constraint on Reviewer+Paper ensures each reviewer-paper pair has at most one review. However, it is not explicitly stated whether Review is identified by (Reviewer, Paper) or independently by ReviewId. The model assumes Review has its own primary identifier (ReviewId), which is consistent with line 7 ('each completed review gets its own review ID'). This should be confirmed: does the conference system assign a separate review ID to each review record, or does the (Reviewer, Paper) pair itself constitute the unique identifier?

ambiguities.description: Mandatory participation in ternary relationship: The transcript confirms that every Review has a ReviewScore and that every Review must have a Reviewer and Paper (because it is the act of a reviewer reviewing a paper). However, it is not explicitly stated whether every Reviewer must participate in at least one review, or whether every Paper must be reviewed by at least one Reviewer. These reverse directions should be clarified.
